A and B share that objective and must follow tie-break rule: among rows that maximize distinct tasks and minimize total cost, select lexicographically smallest (A-task, B-task) pair.

We need to consider all possible A and B choices (each picks one of T1,T2,T3,T4). Then C and D will fill in as per rule.
